# dagsterplus_user_token (Data Source)

Reads an existing Dagster+ user token by label. The token value is not available via this data source — it is only accessible at creation time.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dagsterplus_user_token" "ci" {
  name = "ci-pipeline-token"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The label of the user token to look up.
- `user_id` (String) The ID of the user whose tokens to search.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The token ID assigned by Dagster+.
